entries.en: Small basket; a little basket of plaited bamboo.
entries.notes: H 栏「篮簋底物」四字而 R 栏仅三音，栏间不侔；义从西语 cesto pequeño 与「篮」字。

entries.zh: 箪；竹编小圆筐，多用于盛饭。
entries.en: Dan: a small round basket of split bamboo, chiefly for holding cooked rice.
Chicken basket; a bamboo coop for carrying fowls.

entries.zh: 鱼箪；捕鱼、盛鱼用的竹编鱼篓。
entries.en: Fish basket; a bamboo creel or trap for catching fish.
Basket; a hamper for keeping things.

entries.zh: 贮物用的小竹篮（与上条近义）。
entries.en: Small basket for keeping things; a near-synonym of the preceding entry.
entries.notes: H 栏第二字「笞」于竹器义无取，疑原刻讹字；释义从西语。

entries.en: To cease; to stop; to rest.

entries.zh: 止息；罢休（「厌」取古义「餍足而止」）。
entries.en: To cease; to leave off (厭 in its classical sense: to be sated, hence to stop).
entries.notes: 「厌」与 cessar 之对应牵强，且 M 栏调符 T99 污损难辨，存疑。

entries.en: To cease; (of water) to subside or run dry.
entries.notes: M 栏 zôa 与 H「息」音不侔，疑栏位误置；义从西语 acabarse la agua。

entries.zh: 茶（闽南语称 tê，官话对音 chà）。
entries.notes: 西语释文「Cha:ierna, o garrella」残缺难读；H 栏「恭」当是「茶」之讹，与下条「清明茶」相承。

entries.zh: 清明茶（清明前后所采之茶；煮而饮之，味极佳）。
entries.en: Qingming tea — tea picked at the Qingming festival, boiled and drunk, esteemed very good.
entries.notes: 释文承上条（& cocida se bebe…）；H 栏「荼」原注疑为「茶」，M 栏末音调符 T99 难辨。

entries.en: Zeng-cao: a small fishing sampan worked with a lift-net.
entries.notes: champan 即汉语「舢舨／杉板」之借音（参第 17 条）；「缯」疑为「罾」之借字。

entries.zh: 草艚；覆草篷的大木船（一说为船名专称）。
entries.en: Cao boat with a straw or thatched awning; a large sampan.
entries.notes: H 首字「草」于船名义未详，姑合字面与西语 champán grande 定为大船。
M 栏有[残]，音写不全；义从 H「罟艚」与西语 champan p̃ pescar。

entries.zh: 舢舨；杉木板造之船（champán 一词所自出）。
entries.en: Sampan; a boat built of fir planks — the etymon of Spanish champán.
entries.notes: 此条即西语 champán（舢舨）之语源。

entries.zh: 绫艚；捕鱼大船（船名专称）。
entries.notes: H 首字「绫」于船义无取，疑船名专字或原刻之讹。
